summary: Install any tenant with just an enrollment key, and health-check an installation whenever you want.

new.title: Install a single tenant with an enrollment key
new.text: An enrollment key from Invardia now installs a single-tenant environment too, with its licence included, so no licence file is needed.

new.title: Managed tenants link to their managing tenant
new.text: The managing tenant now shares its details with Invardia by itself, so tenants enrolled with a key are linked to it without manual steps.

new.title: Run the end-of-install check any time
new.text: You can now run the end-of-install check on its own as a health check of an existing installation.

fixes.title: Forgotten offboard requests show as blocking
fixes.text: An approved offboard request that was never queued now counts as a blocking item in the menu badge for 7 days.
